title: Book Three · Chapter 152: What She Brings Back
story:
On Sunday afternoon, Anna meets Ronan beside the park tree.

Her notebook is under one arm. She looks tired, but she smiles when she sees him.

“A long day?” he asks.

“A very hard bus seat.”

He laughs and moves his bag from the bench. Anna sits down and stretches her legs.

For a little while, she tells him about the road. Her mother slept through part of the return journey. Anna tried to read her notes, but the light was poor.

Then she opens the page with the worktable.

“This was the first room.”

Ronan leans closer. She has drawn the long table and several models around it.

“Like the little picture.”

“Much more work than the picture showed.”

She tells him about the two views and the roof. He asks about the part the student lifted.

Anna makes a little shape with her hands. Ronan can picture the rooms beneath it.

“Did you show your stair?”

“Yes. I need the step heights.”

She points to the question beside her own drawing.

“I was looking at the lines. They asked about the size.”

“Did you know it?”

“Not that height.”

Anna shows him a small question mark near the step.

“I could explain the front. Then they asked about this.”

She stops her finger beside the mark. Ronan can see several little notes along the edge of the page.

“Was it difficult?”

“Yes. I wanted to show them a finished drawing.”

He looks at the stair again.

“It still looks good to me.”

“I need it to work too.”

She smiles a little and turns the page back toward herself. She wants to check some real steps before she changes the drawing.

Ronan waits while she reads one of the notes aloud. She does not hide the part she could not answer.

He thinks about the first forty-one on his work label. He liked telling her the funny part afterward. At the time, he wanted the mistake to disappear.

Anna leaves her question beside the stair. It can stay there until she has a size to put in its place.

Ronan looks at the marks. “A tape from zero.”

Anna smiles. She remembers his first work story.

She shows him the shared room next. Her mother asked about space for books and clothes. Anna liked the window and wanted more room beside one bed.

Ronan listens until she closes the notebook.

“At eleven, I thought about your table,” he says.

“I wanted to show it to you.”

“I wanted to be there.”

She nods. Neither speaks for a moment.

Then she puts her hand over his.

“I'm glad I went.”

He looks at her face. “I'm glad you went too.”

She asks about his work morning. Ronan tells her about the cupboard and the man who tried the shelf himself.

“All three mornings finished?”

“All three.”

“What now?”

“Some school work. And a walk with you.”

Anna smiles and puts the notebook back in her bag.

They take the path beside the grass. The wind is cold beyond the trees, so Ronan turns his jacket collar up.

Anna stands closer while he does it. He gives her his arm, and they walk past the empty field together.

At the far end, she begins another story about the model room. Ronan asks her to start with the roof, and she lifts her free hand to show him its shape again.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

return journey＝回程；height＝高度；collar＝衣领；shape＝形状。

## 理解问题

1. Anna带回的有哪些具体见闻和待核对的问题？Ronan怎样认真听她说？
2. 两人是否假装完全不遗憾？Anna有没有为此放弃自己的参观？

## 读句子

**Ronan listens until she closes the notebook.**

拆开看：Ronan / listens / until she closes the notebook.

Ronan／一直听着／直到她合上本子。
